specimens.image_registration: Archived camera frames are already 1024x256 crops. Graph0 stores (row,column) in that camera crop; the supplied graph overlay is a separately rendered/cropped plot and must not be used as an unscaled image-coordinate background.
specimens.target: Image-tracked nodal displacement relative to frame 0, divided by initial graph height
specimens.coordinate_convention: x=column/right; y=row/down; source coordinates in pixels
specimens.progress_limitations: Author's offline compression-window annotation; this phase is not mechanical strain or an independently measured timestamp.
specimens.mask_policy: Missing observations are zero placeholders with mask=False; no interpolation, smoothing, or forward fill.
specimens.label_limitations: Automated image tracking can lose correspondence, merge nodes, and retain pixel quantization; not displacement ground truth from DIC or FEM.
specimens.force_labels: Not exported: only displacement targets are supported by this importer.

specimens.alias_policy: Taieb/Sample_videos aliases and experiment paths are one physical specimen, not extra folds.
specimens.mask_policy: Only explicit workbook matches; all duplicate-coordinate matches masked. Missing labels remain mask=False with zero placeholders. No interpolation or graph carry-forward as labels.
specimens.reference_policy: Every included node exists in graph0, its first pre-coordinate equals graph0, its track is continuous in observed-event order, and every observed coordinate equals the same node in the same archived graph frame. Late first observations retain the true graph0 reference.
specimens.target: Image-tracked displacement relative to frame0 / initial graph height, in image x-right/y-down coordinates.
specimens.progress_limitations: Author's offline compression-window annotation; not measured strain. Exp3/4/5 all use start=20; these annotations were not independently force/time calibrated.
specimens.label_limitations: Automated skeleton matching is a noisy image-derived label, not DIC/FEM ground truth; exact consistency does not establish physical node identity after buckling.
specimens.force_labels: Not imported: no verified synchronization to an independent mechanical force series.

split_rule: Entire physical specimen is one group; aliases, rates and re-extractions never count as independent experiments.
exclusions: Taieb/Exp5 rate10 duplicates the physical specimen represented by rate3; use only rate3.
Later CSV exports have different processing versions; use only the archived original graph+workbook pair.
Graph-carried coordinates without an explicit workbook observation are excluded from labels.
Duplicate-coordinate source matches are excluded in the three newly imported datasets.
new_data_qualification: Three additional physical specimens recovered from existing private repository artifacts. Re-extraction from images is a separate sensitivity analysis; this importer validates and curates the original image extraction.
